business_problem: Global digital services and solutions provider Presidio wanted to drive productivity and create new opportunities for business growth with generative AI capabilities. It wanted to innovate and deliver more customer-centric offerings.
solution_summary: Presidio used Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI Service, Microsoft Dynamics 365 to surface grounded answers from enterprise knowledge faster. Global digital services and solutions provider Presidio wanted to drive productivity and create new opportunities for business growth with generative AI capabilities. It wanted to innovate and deliver more customer-centric offerings. Key implementation elements included Microsoft 365 Copilot applies AI to documents, meetings, mail, and other everyday knowledge work; Azure OpenAI Service generates natural-language responses and task automation for the solution; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Microsoft Azure hosts the application, data, and integrations on scalable cloud infrastructure.
